findings.summary: ST-002 in the SPEC-0001 suite fails: agent.mjs and its test import child_process outside the reviewed allowlist. Code is safe; the allowlist is stale.
scopeFindings does not subtract the session initialChangedPaths, so scope-check attributes pre-existing dirty files to the agent.
One session governs one task of ten. The bootstrap boundary is stated rather than disguised, but it is not a governed phase.
Separation of duty here is two labels, not two minds. This review is itself an example.

notes: REQUEST_CHANGES, not APPROVE: two open defects were found in the session's own output and neither was fixed.
This is an AI review under a different actor label. It satisfies no human gate and does not discharge convergence acceptance at R3.
The reviewer and the executing session share a model. Correlated blind spots are not excluded by this review.
